description:
The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv' is already open in JASP. This dataset contains Big Five personality trait scores for 231 participants. Your goal is to identify 3 distinct personality profiles using K-Means Clustering.

Expected Actions:
1. Enable the 'Machine Learning' module (click the '+' icon in the top module ribbon if not visible).
2. Select Clustering > K-Means Clustering.
3. Assign all 5 trait variables (Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Neuroticism, Openness) as predictors.
4. Set the number of clusters to Fixed: 3.
5. Under 'Training Parameters' or options, ensure 'Add predicted clusters to data' is enabled so the cluster labels are added to the dataset.
6. Under Plots, enable 'Cluster means' to visualize the profiles.
7. Save the analysis as a JASP file to '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFive_KMeans.jasp'.
